translation.name: Nzuwulai n Sa'avu na̱ Tsishingini na̱ a̱ɗiva̱ a na a ɗangulai a Nzuwulai mu Ufaru

content: Azagbain a̱ a̱za̱ e Itoni a̱ Urishelima
Reve waru ama o ro o uta̱ ɗe Yahuda, a̱vu a̱ ꞌya̱wa̱ Antakiya va Suriya, tsa̱ra̱ o roco a̱za̱ e Itoni, a dansaa le, “Na a paɗa ɗu uryumbu ununa Wila̱ wa Musa u dammai shi, ya̱a̱ tsura̱ iwawi shi.”
Adama a adanshiꞌi Bulu na̱ Banaba o sowo ta̱ a yuwusan mawasan lon na amaꞌa. Ɗaɗa a zuwai Bulu na̱ Banaba na ama o ro waru a̱ ꞌya̱wa̱ Urishelima uba̱ta̱ wa ajiya na azagbain adama a adanshiꞌi.

Ana a̱za̱ e Itoni e shewun nle, ana a̱a̱ ka̱mba̱ Urishelima, ɗaɗa a ɓatsai e iɗa ya Finisiya na̱ Samariya. Reve a̱ ka̱lyuwusa̱ a̱za̱ e Itoni a dansaa le adama a na Atakpaci fo a cayi okolo e le. Reve a̱za̱ e Itoni suru a yuwan ma̱za̱nga̱ lon.
Ana a rawai Urishelima, reve a̱za̱ e Itoni suru oɓolo na azagbain na ajiya a raba Bulu na̱ Banaba. Reve a damma le ulinga u na A̱sula̱ a yuwain e ekere e le.
Ɗaɗa aza a na a̱ shi Afarishi kafu a ca okolo e le, a̱ ꞌyoyin reve a damma, “Na a ciga a ꞌyuwan a paɗa le uryumbu, reve waru a zuwa le a̱ kuru Wila̱ wa Musa.”
Reve ajiya† na azagbain a̱ a̱za̱ e Itoni o ɓoloto adama e petelyuwe adanshiꞌi.

Ana a jimai a̱ a̱sa̱la̱ a adanshiꞌi, reve Bituru ꞌyon a̱vu u damma le, “A̱za̱ a̱ va̱, i reve ta̱ ɗe ufaru wi iliꞌi, A̱sula̱ a yuwan ta̱ aɗangulu a̱tsuma̱ a̱ ɗu, a na o una̱ u va̱ u ɗa Atakpaci aa uwwa adanshi a Alabari a Saꞌani,† reve a ca okolo e le.
A̱sula̱ gba za na ri nu urevu wo okolo a̱ koyan ɗa, u yuwaan tsu ta̱ iroci a na u cayi Atakpaci Ruhu va Akiza ununa u ca ntsu.
Agba u roco aɗangulu e ekere a̱ tsu ne ele shi, ana wu za̱za̱ꞌwa̱i okolo e le adama o ucawu wo okolo e le.
Adama o ndolo, adama a̱ nye ya̱a̱ lyungusa̱ A̱sula̱ yaa zuwusaa agbashi a nda itana i na a̱tsu na̱ nkaya n tsu suru tsu kuɗa̱i a tanu?
She tsu yuwain ne wan, tsu reve ta̱ adama e isaꞌani ya̱ Yesu Zagbain i ɗa tsu tsura̱i iwawi† ununa ele fo a̱ tsura̱i.”
Reve oɓolo a amaꞌa suru e isawan kuci kuci, reve o poloo Banaba na̱ Bulu atsuvu a mantsa ma na aa casu alabari a linga va asalama ni iroci i na A̱sula̱ a yuwain uba̱ta̱ wa Atakpaci o ukere u le.
Ana o kotoi adanshi, ɗaɗa Yakubu usuyi, reve u damma, “A̱ɗu a̱za̱ a̱ va̱ poloo numu atsuvu.
Bituru ɗa nda cayi aalabari ununa A̱sula̱ a fara ka̱lyuwa̱i Atakpaci, adama u ɗangwa ama o ro a̱tsuma̱ e le oo oꞌwo ama a̱ yi.
Adanshi a ndaꞌa gba wo oꞌwo ta̱ una̱ta̱ na adanshi a ama̱sula̱, ununa u ri uɗanu a na,

content.text: ‘A̱mu A̱sulazuva, nna̱ n ka̱mbisa̱, n ta suwisa uꞌwa wa̱ Da̱wuda u na u riya̱i.
N ꞌya̱sisa̱n asaꞌa a̱ yi mi isawaton yi.
Adama akapi a ama a zami A̱sulazuva,
oɓolo na Atakpaci na aza a na n ɗeyi a̱ tyo ya̱ꞌa̱ va̱.
A̱yi na u rocoi ili i nda suru diga ɗe a mantsa mo ufaru.’

content: “Adama o ndolo a̱mu a̱ yindi i va̱, she tsu zuwayi Atakpaci a na aa vadalasa uba̱ta̱ wa̱ A̱sula̱ ili yu ume wan.

Amma tsu ɗanaa nle a tawa ekere e le e ili i na a cayi a̱ma̱li adama a na o oꞌwo ta̱ ili yi idaba, waru a suma tsipere. She a tama a̱kutsu a mpasa wan. Waru she a tama nama vi inama i na a̱ punda̱ra̱i wan.
Adama a na ɗe nu ujimu a̱ lyuci biti a yuwusan ta̱ ɗe alajiya na atagada a Musa, waru e ɗesu le ta̱ nu una̱ a̱tsuma̱ a̱ a̱ꞌisa̱ Ashibi biti.”
Mepepelime a̱ tyo a Atakpaci

Reve ajiya, na̱ a̱za̱ e Itoni, na azagbain e le suru e ene u lobono ta̱ a ɗangula ama o ro a̱tsuma̱ e le a̱ lyungu le Antakiya va Suriya oɓolo na̱ Bulu na̱ Banaba. Ɗaɗa a̱ lyunguyi Yahuza (za na a̱ tsu ɗe Basaba) na̱ Sila. Ele ra azagbain a ɗa a̱tsuma̱ a̱ a̱za̱ e Itoni.

Mepepelime ma na a̱ lyunguwa̱ nle na̱ a̱yi, a̱yi ɗa: “A̱ tyo uba̱ta̱ wa Atakpaci a̱za̱ e Itoni a̱tsuma̱ a Antakiya ni iɗa ya Suriya na̱ Kilikiya. “Uba̱ta̱ wa ajiya na azagbain, a̱tsu ɗa a̱za̱ a̱ ɗu a̱ a̱za̱ e Itoni. “Tsu ta̱ ca̱sa̱sa̱ ɗu.
“Tsu uwwa ta̱ a na ama o ro a̱tsuma̱ a̱ tsu a ta damatosun ugbozu u ɗu, agba tsu lyungu le shi.
Ɗaɗa tse enei u lobono ta̱ ana adanshi a̱ ta̱wa̱ ntsu a̱ ta̱, tsu lyunguwa̱ ɗu ama o ro oɓolo na̱ nꞌutsa̱ n tsu Banaba na̱ Bulu.
Ama a na a cayi wuma u le ko ukwa̱, adama a ala e Yesu Zagbain tsu Zamawawa.
Adama a adanshi o ndolo a ɗa fo i zuwai tsu lyunguwa̱ nɗu na̱ Yahuza na̱ Sila adama ele fo a damma ɗu iliꞌi na aciyele.
Adama a na Ruhu va Akiza ene ta̱ u lobono ta̱, a̱tsu fo ne ɗa tse enei, she tsu zuwaa ɗu ume wi ili i na i laꞌai ili i na yaa gura yuwan wan, suru na̱ ne:

I suma utamu wi ili i na a paɗayi a̱ma̱li, nu utamu wi inama oɓolo na̱ mpasa, nu utamu wi ili i na a̱ punda̱ra̱i, na̱ tsipere waru. Ni i guza̱ aciya̱ɗu, ni i yuwan le shi, i ta̱ da̱nu lafiya. “Yo oꞌwo lafiya.”
Ana a ca nle lingataꞌa, reve a̱ ka̱ra̱ a̱ tyo Antakiya, ana a rawai reve o ɓoloto a̱za̱ e Itoni, a̱vu a ca le mepepelimeꞌe.
Ana e ɗeyi mepepelimeꞌe nu una̱, reve a̱ za̱nga̱na̱ adama a na ikaka i na yaa gbamato le okolo a ɗa a̱ ri pe.
Reve Yahuza na̱ Sila a na wo oꞌwoi ele ama̱sula̱ a ɗa, reve a ca a̱za̱ e Itoni a̱sa̱la̱ na̱ a̱bunda̱ a na aa gbama asuvu.
Ana a jimai pe reve a̱za̱ e Itoni e shewun le na abaꞌun a̱ a̱bunda̱, adama a̱ ka̱mba̱ uba̱ta̱ wa aza a na a̱ lyungu nle. [
Sila gba u ɗangwa ta̱ wi isawan waꞌa ne ele a̱tsuma̱ a Antakiya.]
Reve Bulu na̱ Banaba gbaꞌa e isawan pe Antakiya, a̱vu ele na ama o ro aa yuwusan uritosu na alajiya a adanshi a Zagbain.
Mmalu me Ire ma̱ Bulu
Ana a tarai mantsa, reve Bulu damma Banaba, “Tsu ka̱mba̱ tsu bura a̱za̱ e Itoni e ilyuci i na tsu yuwain alajiya a adanshi a Zagbain suru. Adama waru tse ene ununa aa lyuwusa elime.”
Reve Banaba ciga u tara Yahaya† za na waru a̱ tsu ɗe Marku u ꞌya̱wa̱ oɓolo ne ele.
Bulu gba we ene u lobono a tara yi shi, adama a na u kuɗa̱ ta̱ ulingaꞌa waru u lyawa le ta̱ e iɗa ya Bamafiliya.
Reve a yuwan nwasanlai lon, hali u zuwa le a kakasa. Ɗaɗa Banaba tarai Marku, reve a uwa a wantsun a̱ tyo Kuburu.
Reve Bulu gbaꞌa u ɗangwa Sila. Ana a̱za̱ e Itoni a yuwaan nle avasa e isaꞌani ya̱ A̱sula̱, reve a̱ ka̱ra̱.
Reve Bulu na̱ Sila a̱ kurusu a̱za̱ e Itoni e iɗa ya Suriya na̱ Kilikiya adama a gbamato asuvu e le.

footnotes.text: Akuci a Atagada o Ulinga wa Ajiya o ro a̱ ri nu uguzu u nda shi.
